Let \(G\) be the number of Gennadys. Then total

\[
T=45+122+27+G=194+G.
\]

For the 122 Borises to be non-adjacent, we need

\[
122 \le \left\lceil \frac{194+G}{2} \right\rceil.
\]

This is equivalent to

\[
\frac{194+G}{2} > 121 \quad\Rightarrow\quad 194+G \ge 243 \quad\Rightarrow\quad G \ge 49.
\]

With \(G=49\), total \(T=243\). Place the 122 Borises in the 122 odd positions, and place the \(45+27+49=121\) others in the even positions. No two people with the same name are adjacent.

\[
\boxed{49}
\]
